name: Todoist
summary: Todoist is a task management platform that enables users to create to-do lists, set deadlines, collaborate on projects, and manage reminders with cross-platform sync. Through Composio, users can securely connect via managed OAuth and enable AI agents, such as Kimi Code, ChatGPT, and Claude, to interact with Todoist using a large set of tools and triggers, without managing OAuth tokens directly.
decision: Follow the managed OAuth path: Use Composio-managed OAuth to connect Todoist. You do not need to create your own Todoist app or handle OAuth flows yourself. Instead, start your agent or interface (such as Kimi Code), add the Composio MCP server using the documented URL, and authorize via the OAuth prompt when requested within your setup or Composio’s authorization page.

setup_path.note: Composio provides managed OAuth, so you do not need to create or configure your own OAuth client for Todoist unless you have advanced requirements. Setup is completed through interactive agent prompts and the Composio authorization page.

prerequisites.title: Install your AI agent (such as Kimi Code)
prerequisites.body: Install the AI agent you want to use with Todoist (e.g., run the Kimi Code install script or equivalent for your agent).

prerequisites.title: Create (or sign in to) your Composio account
prerequisites.body: You may need to sign in to Composio when prompted during the OAuth flow.

steps.title: Launch and log in to your AI agent
steps.body: Start your agent (for example, run `kimi` if using Kimi Code) and complete its initial login flow.

steps.title: Add Composio MCP server
steps.body: In your agent’s UI, run the command to add a new MCP server and supply the server URL: `https://connect.composio.dev/mcp`. Assign an easy-to-remember name (e.g., Composio).

steps.title: Restart/new session for your agent
steps.body: Restart the agent session so the new Composio MCP server is detected.

steps.title: Initiate OAuth login for Composio within your agent
steps.body: Run the login command for the Composio MCP server in your agent’s UI (e.g., `/mcp-config login Composio`). This will open Composio’s authorization page or provide a URL to visit.

steps.title: Approve the OAuth request
steps.body: On Composio’s authorization page, approve access to your Todoist account. This step authorizes your AI agent to access Todoist using Composio-managed credentials.

steps.title: Confirm successful connection
steps.body: Back in the agent, check that the Composio MCP server is listed as connected and that Todoist-related tools are available.
steps.note: You may test the connection with status commands or attempt a supported Todoist action.

human_actions.title: Sign in and approve OAuth in your browser
human_actions.body: You must personally log in and approve Composio’s request to access your Todoist account during setup.

human_actions.title: Manually trigger setup commands and input the Composio MCP server URL within your agent
human_actions.body: You must enter, paste, or select the Composio MCP server URL during the 'add server' step.
